name: voice_core_e2e_acceptance_v1
_comment: ADR-0022 GATE-1 acceptance contract for voice_core_suite_v1.json.
Top-level expected_tool_calls is AND-semantics: every listed tool must appear
at least once in the whole run. Only stop_music is expected — the other steps
(command-intent gate, new-session reset, wake word) deliberately bypass the LLM
or call no tools, so listing them would force a false FAIL.
must_not_call stays EMPTY: none of these commands should globally forbid any
tool (per-step constraints live in the scenario steps).
